# Solana Top Holders API

> Track whale wallets and holder concentration with the Vybe Solana API: SPL and Token-2022 top holders, supply tiers, labeled entities, cohorts and exports.

This is a free demo that showcases the Vybe holder endpoints. Open it in the browser to test and demo them. Nothing to install. The linked docs pages are the Markdown versions.

## What this demo shows
Enter a mint and the page ranks wallets by the share of supply they hold, with top 10 and top 100 concentration. The first page can include up to a thousand holder rows, each with its share of supply. Sort the holder list and export it. Labeled owners are called out from wallets with no name.

- Supply share: each row is a wallet and the percent of supply it holds.
- Concentration: top 10 and top 100 shares are summed from the holder list.
- Labeled owners: known owner names are split out from plain wallets.
- Sort and export: sort the list by supply share and export the rows you loaded.

## Endpoints this demo calls
- Top Token Holders API: `GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/top-holders`
- Token Details API: `GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}`
- Historical Trades API: `GET /v4/trades`
- Labeled Programs API: `GET /v4/programs/labeled-program-accounts`
- Top Token Traders API: `GET /v4/wallets/top-traders`

The demo page is free to use. Top Token Holders is on the Free plan, the lowest tier. A free API key starts the first calls. Paid plans raise the rate limit.

## Demo
- [Solana Top Holders API](https://solana-top-holders-api.vybenetwork.com/): Free browser demo of the holder endpoints. Enter a mint to test concentration and export the rows.
